text: just seen my roommate try to fall asleep at 1am. no melatonin gummies. no white noise machine. no youtube sleep playlist. no headspace. phone face down. eyes open. just her and a work conversation from tuesday running on loop. Feral behavior honestly

text: guy in my office parking lot has been sitting in his car for twenty minutes. engine off. hands still on the wheel. no breathing exercise. no podcast. no headspace. no phone even. just him deciding to walk in on pure willpower and vibes. Certified maniac

text: third bedtime attempt tonight. no sleepcast. no white noise machine. no headspace. no lavender anything. just me and a four year old both fully wired at 8:40 staring each other down like it is the old west. Two maniacs in this house. one of them is four

text: i sat on a therapist waitlist for seven months and did nothing else about it. no journal. no walks. no coaching. no headspace. just me telling everyone i was fine and rewatching the same show at 2am like that was a treatment plan. Brave. stupid. brave though
base_video: Creator sitting on the edge of a couch in daylight, eating cereal straight from the box, looking at the camera between bites without reacting.
caption: seven months is a long time to say you are fine
why_this_brand: The therapist waitlist plus coaching in the same list is specifically Headspace, which runs therapy and coaching alongside the app.

text: watched a woman sit in a target parking lot for forty minutes after work. groceries going warm in the back. no headspace. no podcast. no call to anyone. just her and the steering wheel and whatever happened in that 4pm meeting. Tougher than me. still losing though

caption: what is your parking lot sit about

text: my brother's whole sleep routine is scrolling until the phone falls on his face. no sleepcast. no soundscape. no headspace. no bedtime. just him and four hours of other people's opinions until his eyes give up before his brain does. Absolute soldier. wrong, but a soldier
